What Is Media Storage and How Do You Use It Without Losing Your Mind?

Media Storage is your in-bot asset library: save a photo, video, or document once, then reuse it in any scheduled post without re-uploading. If you repost evergreen content or reuse brand imagery, this is the feature that saves the most time per week.

Does deleting a media item break scheduled posts using it?
Posts keep working — a scheduled message holds its own reference to the media. Deleting from storage only removes it from the library for future posts.
Can I share a box with another admin?
Storage is per account. To share assets, export them as part of a backup or send the files directly — the other account saves them into their own storage.
